title: Queen's Gambit Declined: Ragozin Defense
line: Black pins the knight on c3 with a bishop, and White breaks the pin.

steps.text: Black's bishop pins your knight on c3 to the king. The knight cannot move, so it could not take back on e4.

wrong.e2e4: Black takes the pawn, and the pinned knight on c3 cannot take back.

also.c1g5: That pins Black's knight at once, another main line. This lesson trades on d5 first.
also.d1a4: That check attacks the bishop too, another main line. This lesson trades on d5 first.

steps.text: Bring the bishop out and pin Black's knight in turn. The knight guards the pawn on d5.
Trade the bishop for the knight. After the queen takes back, nothing guards the pawn on d5, but your pinned knight cannot take it yet.

also.g5h4: Keeping the pin is sound too. This lesson trades on f6.

steps.text: Bring the queen out with check. It also attacks the bishop on b4.
steps.after: Black blocks with the knight, which also guards the bishop.

steps.text: Move the pawn in front of your king one square to free your other bishop.
Bring the bishop out so that you can castle.
Castle. Your king leaves the line of the bishop on b4, and the knight on c3 is free to move.
steps.after: The pin is gone, and White can turn its pieces on the pawn on d5.

summary: Black pins the knight to the king. White trades on the center first, then castles out of the pin.
